name: Receply — Sheet Sync (rooms in, reservations out)

parameters.query:
-- every run also expires lapsed holds (status held -> expired), so the room is free again
WITH lapsed AS (SELECT receply_expire_holds(NULL) AS n)
SELECT account_id, business_name, sheet_id, coalesce(timezone, 'Europe/Belgrade') AS timezone, coalesce(alert_topic, '') AS alert_topic, coalesce(sheet_sync_error, '') AS prev_error, coalesce(mirror_hash, '') AS prev_hash FROM receply_clients CROSS JOIN lapsed ORDER BY account_id

SELECT r.ticket AS "Ticket", coalesce(r.booking_no::text, '') AS "Booking no.", CASE WHEN r.status = 'held' THEN 'held (waiting for the guest)' ELSE r.status END AS "Status",
       btrim(coalesce(g.first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(g.last_name, '')) AS "Guest", coalesce(g.phone, '') AS "Phone", coalesce(g.email, '') AS "Email",
       coalesce(r.room_number, '') AS "Room", coalesce(r.guests_count::text, '') AS "Guests", coalesce(r.check_in::text, '') AS "Check-in", coalesce(r.check_out::text, '') AS "Check-out",
       coalesce(r.channel, '') AS "Channel", to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE $2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Booked at",
       coalesce(to_char(r.cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE $2, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '') AS "Cancelled at", coalesce(r.note, '') AS "Note"
  FROM receply_reservations r LEFT JOIN receply_guests g ON g.id = r.guest_id
 WHERE r.account_id = $1::int AND r.status <> 'expired'
 ORDER BY (r.check_out IS NULL OR r.check_out < current_date), r.check_in NULLS LAST, r.id

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN $3::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
    AS x(room_number text, room_type text, persons int, description text, extra jsonb, sheet_row int)
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO receply_rooms AS rr (account_id, room_number, room_type, persons, description, extra, sheet_row, active, updated_at)
  SELECT $1::int, room_number, room_type, persons, description, coalesce(extra, '{}'::jsonb), sheet_row, true, now() FROM incoming
  ON CONFLICT (account_id, room_number) DO UPDATE
    SET room_type = EXCLUDED.room_type, persons = EXCLUDED.persons, description = EXCLUDED.description, extra = EXCLUDED.extra,
        sheet_row = EXCLUDED.sheet_row, active = true,
        updated_at = CASE WHEN (rr.room_type, rr.persons, rr.description, rr.extra, rr.active) IS DISTINCT FROM
                              (EXCLUDED.room_type, EXCLUDED.persons, EXCLUDED.description, EXCLUDED.extra, true) THEN now() ELSE rr.updated_at END
  RETURNING 1
), gone AS (
  UPDATE receply_rooms SET active = false, updated_at = now()
   WHERE $2::boolean AND account_id = $1::int AND active AND room_number NOT IN (SELECT room_number FROM incoming)
  RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE receply_clients SET sheet_synced_at = now(), sheet_sync_error = nullif($4, ''), mirror_hash = nullif($5, '')
 WHERE account_id = $1::int
RETURNING account_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM up) AS rooms_saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM gone) AS rooms_switched_off, sheet_sync_error
